rescueTop10.significance: Born to Philip II and Olympias on the day Ephesus’ Temple of Artemis burned (Plutarch 2–3).
Turns Bucephalas into the sun and studies Homer’s Iliad and science under Aristotle (Plutarch 6–8).

rescueTop10.event: Battle of Chaeronea & Attalus Wedding Brawl
rescueTop10.significance: Breaks Sacred Band at Chaeronea (338 BC), then clashes with Attalus and Philip at the 337 BC wedding feast (Plutarch 9).

rescueTop10.event: Assassination of Philip II at Aegae
rescueTop10.significance: Bodyguard Pausanias kills Philip II (Diodorus 16.91–94); Alexander secures throne and leaves Antipater in Macedon.
Cleitus saves Alexander at Granicus (Arrian 1.14–16); cuts Gordian Knot (Arrian 2.3); defeats Darius III at Issus.

rescueTop10.event: Siege of Tyre & Oracle of Zeus Ammon at Siwah
rescueTop10.significance: Storms island Tyre via mole (Arrian 2.24) and is hailed son of Zeus Ammon at Siwah.

rescueTop10.event: Battle of Gaugamela & Burning of Persepolis
rescueTop10.significance: Decisive victory over Darius III (Plutarch 31–33; Arrian 3.9–15; Astronomical Diary) followed by burning Xerxes’ palace (Plutarch 38; Arrian 3.18).

rescueTop10.event: Murder of Cleitus, Proskynesis & Rock of Aornus
rescueTop10.significance: Spears Cleitus the Black in drunken rage at Maracanda, clashes with Callisthenes over proskynesis (Arrian 4.8–12), and storms Aornus (Arrian 4.28–30).

rescueTop10.event: Hyphasis Mutiny, Gedrosian Desert, Susa Weddings & Opis
rescueTop10.significance: Army halts at River Hyphasis; marches across Gedrosia; mass Persian-Macedonian weddings at Susa (Arrian 7.4) and death of Hephaestion (Arrian 7.14).
Dies aged 32 after fever and heavy banqueting amid poison rumours (Plutarch 73–77; Arrian 7.24–30).
